name: Minimum coin change
prompt: Find the minimum number of coins for an amount using unlimited copies of each given denomination. Read n and amount, followed by n positive denominations. Print one integer, or -1 if impossible. 1 <= n <= 20, 0 <= amount <= 1000. For amount zero print zero.

name: Longest strictly increasing subsequence
prompt: Read n, then n integers. Print the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence (elements may be skipped). 0 <= n <= 500. Print 0 for an empty sequence.

name: Maximum nonempty subarray
prompt: Read n, then n integers, and print the largest sum of any nonempty contiguous subarray. 1 <= n <= 1000. Each integer is between -1000 and 1000.

name: Grid paths with blocked cells
prompt: Read rows and cols (1 to 10 each) and then that many rows of characters, with . for open and # for blocked. Print the number of paths from top left to bottom right moving only right or down through open cells. A blocked start or finish means zero paths.
